title: Hotel Block Pickup Rate
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp hotel_room_offered=yes
| stats sum(eval(if(hotel_booked="yes",1,0))) as booked, count as offered by hotel_block
| eval pickup_pct=round(100*booked/offered,1)
| sort - pickup_pct
description: Measures how well each hotel block is being used by invited guests.
value: Unused hotel blocks can become avoidable cost or logistics issues, especially near release deadlines.
implementation: Store hotel offer and booking state in RSVP data and calculate pickup percentage by block.
visualization: Table of hotel blocks with pickup percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which guest hotel blocks are getting used and which ones may be too large.
